correctness.rationale: For any curve avoiding the apex, lift its azimuth and develop it into the plane. If the absolute developed angular change is at least pi, meeting the opposite ray already gives a total length at least s+t; for smaller absolute changes the chord bound increases with the angle. The shortest representative has angle q delta <= pi q < pi and its chord stays within the radial disk. The same s+t bound applies to paths through the apex. The developed and Cartesian chords give the stated quotient after division by 4st. Area sampling gives independent delta uniform on [0,pi] and U=log(s/t) with density exp(-2|U|). The quotient decreases with |U| at every delta>0; on U=0 its increase with delta follows from the decrease of x cot(x). This gives precisely the maximizers, essential support and invertible endpoint K(q); lateral area pi q L^2 then fixes scale. For 1<lambda<K, solving the quotient inequality yields the stated Q and the interval |U|<2 asinh(sqrt(Q)), giving the displayed strict survival integral, including the stated endpoint probabilities. At delta=pi and U=0, the linear coefficient of pi-delta is cos(pi q/2)/2 and the quadratic coefficient of U is (sin^2(pi q/2)-q^2)/(8q^3 sin(pi q/2)). Large |U| forces Z to 1 uniformly, so the local expansion controls the entire upper excursion. Its rescaled region has area 8/(3 A_q sqrt(B_q)); the sampling density tends uniformly to 1/pi after factoring out the Jacobian. This proves both the precise coefficient and the uniform conditional limit.

value.rationale: Pairwise metric distortion measures how much an embedded surface underestimates intrinsic travel when straight 3D chords are used. The endpoint identifies the cone opening, but it alone says nothing about how often this distortion is approached. The exact law, leading frequency and conditional scales quantify that gap for the natural area measure and are not determined by intrinsic-distance moments or the single opposite-rim computation.
residual_risks: No uniform endpoint rate across degenerating openings or statistical shape-estimation performance is claimed.
